name: Java Generic
author: grandpaacademy
description: A generic Java egg for running Java/JAR applications. Supports git clone, maven/gradle builds, and custom JAR execution.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z ${MAVEN_SETTINGS} ]]; then export MAVEN_OPTS="-s ${MAVEN_SETTINGS}"; fi; if [ -f /home/container/pom.xml ] && [ ! -f /home/container/target/*.jar ]; then mvn clean package -DskipTests; fi; if [ -f /home/container/build.gradle ] && [ ! -f /home/container/build/libs/*.jar ]; then ./gradlew shadowJar || ./gradlew build; fi; if [ ! -z "${JAR_FILE}" ]; then exec java ${JAVA_ARGS} -jar /home/container/${JAR_FILE}; else echo "No JAR_FILE specified!"; exit 1; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Java App Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip maven
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            exit 10
        fi
    fi
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        git pull
    fi
else
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/pom.xml ]; then
    echo "Building with Maven..."
    mvn clean package -DskipTests
elif [ -f /mnt/server/build.gradle ]; then
    echo "Building with Gradle..."
    chmod +x gradlew 2>/dev/null || true
    if [ -f gradlew ]; then
        ./gradlew shadowJar || ./gradlew build
    fi
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Git repo to clone. I.E. https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: What branch to pull from github. Default is blank to pull the repo default branch.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Skip all the install stuff if you are letting a user upload files. 0 = false (default) 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.

variables.name: JAR File
variables.description: The JAR file to run. Include path if not in root (e.g. target/app.jar or build/libs/app.jar)

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Password to use with git. It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
